_comment: THE redirect map for the site — one source of truth.
Add a line here and run `python3 tools/build_redirects.py`. That regenerates
all three layers at once, so they can never drift apart:
3. a fallback stub HTML page at each   (works on ANY host, even with no
old path                             server config at all)
Never hand-edit the generated block in .htaccess, the _redirects file, or
anything under the old paths — the next build overwrites them.
These are permanent. Removing one throws away the search ranking and any
backlinks that the old URL still carries.
